models.title: Covered-interest-parity forward rate with simple accrual
models.summary: The owner text computes the forward quote from spot and simple interest growth factors over the matched maturity.

relationship.original_equation: Forward A/B = spot A/B × (1 + A rate × year fraction) / (1 + B rate × year fraction)
relationship.locator: Introduction and Section 2, covered interest parity equation
relationship.translation_notes: A/B × dimensionless gross-factor ratio yields A/B. Year fraction is dimensionless and no fixed day-count conversion is embedded.

assumptions: Interest rates, spot and forward share matching settlement dates, currency pair and term.

Simple accrual must not be substituted for compound growth over mismatched maturities.
